sources.title: GitHub - MattiaToffolo/Scientific-Contradiction-Detector: End-to-end AI ...
sources.snippet: End-to-end AI system for automated scientific literature review. Type a biomedical claim, get a structured evidence report: which papers support it, which contradict it, and a written synthesis. Built with local LLMs (Ollama + llama3.2), RAG (ChromaDB + sentence-transformers), and Streamlit. Zero cost, fully private.
